Topic: Native Americans
Are you a single homeschool family looking for more educational opportunities? This class is for you!
Only 30 students will be allowed to register for the in-person class. The class will be taught at a 3rd thru 6th-grade level, but all ages are welcome. This class will be $2 per person including students, parents, chaperones, and siblings. To register you must pay in advance due to limited capacity. This does not include anyone under the age of 3.
Participants will dive into the Native American culture that existed before the arrival of Europeans and briefly discuss the effects of colonial expansion. Participants will then learn the story of the corn husk doll and then make one to take home.
Time: 10:00 am – 11:00 am
Program Fee: $2 per person-registration required for adult(s) and child(s)
Meeting Place: Interpretive Center
Age Limit: All ages, under 13 accompanied by an adult
